description: This file defines functions related to platform image upgrade checks and procedures for a specific hardware platform in the OpenWRT project. It includes a function to check the image and another to perform the upgrade, leveraging default upgrade behavior.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image, currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade by calling a default upgrade function with the provided argument.
